about_the_game:
"Heartbeat in Thailand" is a live-action interactive game. After struggling to find work post-graduation, you join your uncle in Thailand for his "big business" – only to be stood up at the airport. Fortunately, your caring cousin helps you settle in. But why does his villa feel so eerie? At midnight, a mischievous ghost haunts you! After escaping, a gang's seductive leader chases you yelling "Husband!" Even the glamorous performer who saves you hides dark secrets?

Gentle & Lovely Cousin — Xiao Shui

Mischievous Ghost Girl — Nana

Mysterious Show Star — Sherry

Ice-Cold Beauty Widow — Shen Man

Surrounded by beauties, adventures unfold relentlessly. Every choice triggers butterfly effects: blissful harem or bloody storms! Stay vigilant—each step treads on thin ice!

Immersive VR View -

1st-person perspective filming thrusts you into exotic adventures. Ultra-realistic scenes make you feel present.

Branching Endings -

Choices create diverse outcomes: joyful, tragic, or shocking! Beauties' fates lie in your hands.

Bonus System -

Unique item mechanics! Collect props to unlock hidden scenes and character interactions.

Karma Justice -

Revenge served hot! Gang bosses, thugs, playboys... those who cross you WILL pay.

Thai Vibes -

Shot on location! Feast on Southeast Asian landscapes and exotic beauties.

On the eve of filming "Heartbeat in Thailand", actor Wang was scammed, stirring an online uproar. We in Thailand felt uneasy, never expecting the game's storyline to unfold in real life. However, thanks to the cast and crew's persistence and effort (we really shot as if our lives were on the line, haha), filming was completed smoothly.

We look forward to your feedback after playing "Heartbeat in Thailand" to help us grow and improve the game—be it gameplay, UI, cinematography, script, or other aspects.

Thanks to all our players, new and returning—especially those who played our previous titles "Secrets of the Heartbeat" and "Hello Love: 18 Again"—for your encouragement and criticism. Your support keeps us going.

We also hope that new players who enjoy "Heartbeat Adventure: Thai Encounter" will try our other cinematic games. Thank you all!

We will keep improving and learning, aiming to bring you more and better cinematic games!

content_descriptors.notes:
Mild Violence: Non-bloody fighting scenes.
Realistic Violence: Includes blood (e.g., gunshots, stabbings), group fights, and humiliating violent scenes.
Language: Contains mild profanity, swearing, and curses.
Suicide: Depicts character suicide (e.g., using a grenade to die together with enemies).
Criminal Acts: Includes kidnapping, assault, gambling, and interrogation with restraints.
Horror Elements: Enclosed spaces (e.g., attics) and ghosts (spirit forms of deceased characters).
Sexual Content: Revealing clothing (swimsuits, bikinis), partial nudity or implied nudity (e.g., bare back while changing clothes, body close-ups during dancing).
Legal Drugs: Depictions of drinking and smoking.
Adult Venues: Features bars, casinos, and nightclubs.
Illegal Drugs: Includes use of knockout drugs (causing unconsciousness after inhalation or drinking).

short_description: Freshly graduated, you head to Bangkok’s Chinatown to find your uncle—only to lose contact. Seeking a steady job, you’re mistaken for a gang boss and thrown into chaos. Along the way, you meet a sweet cousin, cold widow, mysterious performer, quirky ghost, and even... someone unexpected.
